title: Mysterious Potion

sources.title: Unstable Blood
markers: | summary = '''Unstable Blood''' is a permanent passive feature which causes a creature's blood to explode when in contact with fire.

sources.title: Unstable Blood (surface)
markers: | summary = a [[surface]] created when a creature with the passive feature [[Unstable Blood]] is damaged and bleeds. Instead of {{Area|Blood}}, they will create an Unstable Blood surface.

summary: Drink Formula Gruna to permanently gain Unstable Blood after Test Subject ends.

fields.On drinking: Test Subject lasts 1 turn. At expiry, the drinker takes 1d4 Slashing, explodes and creates Fire, then gains Unstable Blood.
fields.Unstable Blood: This permanent passive replaces Blood surfaces produced by the character with Unstable Blood. Fire damage makes the surface explode and apply Burning for 3 turns, then leaves a Fire surface.
fields.Acquisition: Donate blood to Araj Oblodra in Act Two, then take the formula at Crimson Draughts in Act Three.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
